name: spacey
description: Falcon 9-class first-stage landing sim + in-browser CMA-ES trainer

scripts.setup: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p spacey_sim --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/src/pkg --out-name spacey target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/spacey_sim.wasm
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm --prefix web run build
